summary: Nscale Serverless Inference gives every new account $5 of free credit to explore its models. When ready to scale, users add a payment card to purchase additional credit. The docs quickstart separately notes early users may be eligible for free credits and to check for promotional offers.
claim_steps: Sign up for an Nscale account
Claim your free credit and create your API key
Add a payment card later to purchase additional credit
